positioning.summary: Software engineer with 15+ years of experience building complex, real-world systems across industrial, spatial computing, and data-heavy domains. Operates at a staff level - designing systems across boundaries (APIs, data flows, and user interfaces) and turning ambiguous, high-dimensional problems into usable, high-performance products.Takes ownership of systems end-to-end, contributes to architectural direction, and acts as a technical anchor within teams - unblocking engineers, providing clarity in ambiguous situations, and helping drive pragmatic decisions across product and engineering.
strengths: Designing and building systems at the boundary of backend complexity and user experience
End-to-end ownership: from shaping product direction to production systems
Navigating ambiguity and defining structure in poorly defined problem spaces
Architectural decision-making under real-world constraints (performance, legacy, integrations)
Mentoring engineers and elevating system-level thinking across teams
selectedImpact: Led the evolution of the frontend platform for an industrial plant control system, enabling engineers to compose and operate real-world plant configurations across deployments; contributed to architectural decisions and company-wide initiatives including shared component systems and frontend standards.

Bootstrapped a spatial computing platform for a San Francisco-based startup as the first engineer, designing and implementing the system from scratch (Babylon.js, React, RxJS) and establishing architecture for real-time, time-based data visualization.

Drove a major modernization effort for a US-based financial platform, transitioning from a legacy monolith to a Next.js-based system with API layer; handled complex integrations (e-commerce, learning platforms, SSO) while stepping into architecture, client communication, and coordination roles during a critical phase.
recognition: Speaker at FrontKon 2024 (biggest Czech frontend conference)
